definition_en: The ability to examine information, identify patterns or problems, compare alternatives, investigate causes, and draw conclusions based on evidence.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk meneliti maklumat, mengenal pasti corak atau masalah, membandingkan alternatif, menyiasat punca, dan membuat kesimpulan berdasarkan bukti.
typical_tasks_en:
• Compare monthly sales performance and explain unusual changes.
• Analyse customer complaint data to identify recurring service issues.
• Evaluate three suppliers based on cost, quality, and delivery performance.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Bandingkan prestasi jualan bulanan dan terangkan perubahan yang luar biasa.
• Analisis data aduan pelanggan untuk mengenal pasti isu perkhidmatan berulang.
• Nilai tiga pembekal berdasarkan kos, kualiti dan prestasi penghantaran.
inclusion_rules:
• Compare data, options, or outcomes
• Identify patterns, trends, or anomalies
• Investigate causes of a problem
• Evaluate evidence before making a decision
• Interpret information rather than only collect it
exclusion_rules:
• Copying or entering data without interpretation
• Following a fixed checklist without judgment
• Formatting an existing report without analysing its content
• Sending or collecting information only
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task mentions data or reports but no analysis verb (compare, investigate, evaluate, interpret). Do not infer analysis from the word 'report' alone.

confusions.boundary_rule: Use Analytical thinking for evidence, patterns, comparisons, and causes. Use Systems thinking when the focus is how multiple parts of a system interact.
confusions.example_task: Assess how staffing levels, delivery delays, and inventory shortages together affect customer satisfaction.

confusions.boundary_rule: Use Analytical thinking to interpret evidence or diagnose causes. Use Quality control to check work against a defined standard.
confusions.example_task: Check completed reports against the compliance checklist.

confusions.boundary_rule: Use Analytical thinking to understand an existing problem. Use Creative thinking to generate novel ideas or solutions.
confusions.example_task: Analyse why customers abandon checkout and design three new solutions.
